dispute.claim_text: AMK to Raffles Place is CTE straight down, 14km, I do it every week. Saturday night he take me through Novena, Newton, then Kim Seng Road, 17.6km. With surge somemore. $36.60 for a trip that is normally $28. I know support will say I complain a lot but look at the map lah.

counterparty_statement.text: Saturday night the CTE into town is always jammed near Chin Swee. I went by Newton and Kim Seng to avoid it. It was faster for the passenger.

admissibility.notes: Trip record complete and causally ordered.

payload.optimal_route_source: routing-engine-v3.2 (LTA traffic snapshot 21:07; optimal is CTE southbound throughout)

issue_details.detail: A 331.8 m position jump between the fix at 21:44:57 and its neighbours at 21:44:52 and 21:45:02, in the Raffles Place urban canyon, with reported accuracy degrading to 42 m on the outlier. Over the 250 m GPS_DRIFT_M threshold; under the 500 m jump limb in POL-RD-07.

The same pair of intervals implies 193.6 kph into the outlier and 238.9 kph out of it, both far over the 130.0 IMPLAUSIBLE_SPEED_KPH threshold. A drift outlier necessarily implies an impossible speed, and a conforming pre-pass declares both codes rather than only the spatial one.

admissibility.notes: Classic multipath outlier on the final approach. The trace is down-weighted for admissibility to 0.30 but is NOT impaired for policy: POL-RD-07 needs a gap over 90 s, a jump over 500 m or a sustained interval over 30 s, and none is present. A deviation may still be established on it, and the Judge must say both things.
Rider query and driver reply, both delivered and read.
